findings.current: Some had lost comrades and lovers.
findings.defect: Separates a single person who was both a comrade and a lover into plural groups.
findings.rationale: 전우이자 연인 describes one person with both relationships.
findings.replacement: Some had lost a comrade who was also a lover.

findings.current: “Never here? Then was the whole thing a trap to lure us into going after something else?”
findings.defect: Changes the trap’s possible target into something the Hunters would be lured into pursuing.
findings.rationale: 다른 것을 노린 says the trap was aimed at something else; it does not say the Hunters would pursue that thing.
findings.replacement: “Never here? Then was it a trap aimed at something else from the start?”
findings.source: “처음부터? 그럼 애초에 다른 것을 노린 함정이었다는 겁니까?”

findings.current: “If we keep pursuing them without rest, the units will fall apart in no time. First, we need to regroup the Hunters who are worked up as quickly as possible.”
findings.defect: Turns Jin’s direct instruction to his listeners into a general statement about what ‘we’ need to do.
findings.rationale: 수습하세요 directly tells the listeners to rein in the excited Hunters.
findings.replacement: “If we keep pursuing them without rest, the units will fall apart in no time. First, get the worked-up Hunters back under control as quickly as you can.”
findings.source: “지금 이대로 쉬지 않고 추격을 이어 가면 부대는 순식간에 와해 됩니다. 우선 최대한 빨리 흥분한 헌터들을 수습하세요.”

findings.current: The idea that the pursuer is more desperate than the one being chased is complete bullshit.
findings.defect: Reverses which side the narrator says people assume is more desperate.
findings.rationale: The Korean rejects the claim that the fugitive is more desperate than the pursuer.
findings.replacement: The idea that the one being chased is more desperate than the pursuer is complete bullshit.
findings.source: 추격자보다 도망자가 조급하다는 것은 전부 개소리다.

findings.current: I cursed under my breath and gazed up at the darkening sky.
findings.defect: Makes the curse audible when the narrator curses inwardly.
findings.rationale: 내심 locates the curse in his thoughts, not under his breath.
findings.replacement: I cursed to myself and gazed up at the darkening sky.
findings.source: 나는 내심 욕설을 중얼거리며 어두워지는 하늘을 바라봤다.

findings.current: Looking like blood-soaked corpses themselves, they chased down their prey.
findings.defect: Adds corpses to a description of living Hunters covered in blood.
findings.rationale: 혈인 means a blood-covered person, not a corpse.
findings.replacement: Looking like people made of blood, they chased down their prey.
findings.source: 핏물을 흠뻑 뒤집어쓴 헌터들은 혈인(血人)이나 다름없는 몰골로 사냥감을 좇았다.

findings.current:
> Information for the special debuff **[Damaged Body]** has been updated.
>
> The special debuff **[Broken Body]** has been newly applied.
findings.defect: Retains square brackets around UI terms inside an already framed System panel.
findings.rationale: The binding System-panel format identifies UI terms without enclosing them in square brackets.
findings.replacement:
> Information for the special debuff **Damaged Body** has been updated.
>
> The special debuff **Broken Body** has been newly applied.
findings.source:
- 특수 디버프, [망가진 신체]의 정보가 갱신됩니다.

- 특수 디버프, [부서진 신체]가 새롭게 부여됩니다.

summary: Several action and relationship details are altered, including a reversed comparison about the pursuit.
